source: Questions whose correct answer on the live graph is empty or a zero count (absent property, impossible filter combination, zero count). Drafted with an AI assistant and verified against the endpoint on 15 Nov 2026; to be checked by a human author.

items.question: Which data collection methods were used by empirical studies published before 1990?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?method_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c ; orkgp:P29 ?y . ?c a orkgc:C27001 ; orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?m . ?m rdfs:label ?method_label . FILTER(xsd:integer(?y) < 1990) }

items.question: Which analysis techniques are reported for the data analysis methods of the studies?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?technique_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C27001 ; orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da orkgp:P1005 ?m . ?m orkgp:P218006 ?t . ?t rdfs:label ?technique_label . }

items.question: How many studies report the evaluation approach of their data analysis methods?
goldQueries: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?n_studies) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C27001 ; orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da orkgp:P1005 ?m . ?m orkgp:P218007 ?e . }

items.question: Which NLP4RE studies used more than 1000 annotators?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?n_annotators WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C121001 ; orkgp:P181031 ?ap . ?ap orkgp:P181032 ?an . ?an orkgp:P59120 ?n_annotators . FILTER(xsd:integer(?n_annotators) > 1000) }

items.question: Which ecology and evolution studies conducted in Antarctica follow an experimental approach?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?approach_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C65000 ; orkgp:HAS_APPROACH ?a ; <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/wikidata:P30> ?k . ?a rdfs:label ?approach_label . ?k rdfs:label ?kl . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?kl)) = "antarctica" && CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?approach_label)), "experiment")) }

items.templateTitle: Overview of data for wind energy potential assessment
items.question: Which offshore wind energy assessments measure wind speed at a height of more than 200 metres?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?height_value WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C92000 ; orkgp:P37537 ?l ; orkgp:P71179 ?h . ?l rdfs:label ?ll . ?h orkgp:P71048 ?height_value . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?ll)) = "offshore" && xsd:decimal(?height_value) > 200) }

items.question: What sample sizes do the study populations of nutritional and metabolic disease studies have?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?sample_size WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C123091 ; orkgp:P15377 ?s . ?s orkgp:P57104 ?sample_size . }

items.question: What is the age of the study populations in nutritional and metabolic disease studies?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?age_value WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C123091 ; orkgp:P15377 ?s . ?s orkgp:P59214 ?q . ?q orkgp:P45075 ?age_value . }

items.question: How many studies on obesity were conducted in Antarctica?
goldQueries: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?n_studies) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C123091 ; orkgp:P134011 ?d ; orkgp:P135009 ?a . ?d rdfs:label ?dl . ?a rdfs:label ?al . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dl)) = "obesity" && LCASE(STR(?al)) = "antarctica") }

items.question: Which types of samples are analysed when measuring food components?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?sample_type WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C123091 ; orkgp:P62073 ?f . ?f orkgp:P20080 ?s . ?s orkgp:P35184 ?sample_type . }
